records.researcher_notes: The Southern Company generator interconnection queue, read through its Power BI report at https://www.southerncompany.info/power-bi/transmission-policy-services/index.html, lists request 26-IC-1425 in Clarke County, Mississippi. It is a combined cycle gas project of 785 MW (991 MVA) connecting at the Enterprise substation 230 kV bus. The request was received on 3/26/2026, its status is Active, it is in the cluster study, and the requested in-service date is 5/1/2032. The queue note reads: "Affiliate request. Scoping Meeting scheduled for May 14, 2026." That means a Southern Company affiliate filed it, most likely Mississippi Power, but no filing says which one. The Power BI report needs a script to load, so the verifier cannot read it. The same row is copied at https://www.interconnection.fyi/project/southern-company-26-ic-1425, which passed the verifier and is cited here. Because that copy is a lead site, every value stays at medium confidence until a Mississippi Power or Public Service Commission filing names the project. Mississippi Power's 2024 resource plan at https://www.synapse-energy.com/mississippi-power-company-2024-integrated-resource-plan names no new gas plant. The plant is named after its substation and county because the request has no other name. Not found: the owner, the plant name, the turbine model, the exact site and the coordinates. Southern Company's queue note calls request 26-IC-1425 an affiliate request, but it does not say which affiliate. No Mississippi Public Service Commission filing or Mississippi Power announcement names this project, so the owner is blank. Mississippi Power is a likely candidate but is not confirmed.

records.researcher_notes: The Southern Company generator interconnection queue, read through its Power BI report at https://www.southerncompany.info/power-bi/transmission-policy-services/index.html, lists two requests in Clarke County, Mississippi, both received on 4/3/2026: 26-IC-1489 and 26-IC-1490. Each is a gas combustion turbine of 199.4 MW (369.1 MVA) connecting on the Laurel East to Sykes substation 230 kV line, with a requested in-service date of 5/1/2029. Both are Active and in the cluster study. The queue gives no owner or plant name. The Power BI report needs a script to load, so the verifier cannot read it. The same rows are copied at https://www.interconnection.fyi/project/southern-company-26-ic-1489 and https://www.interconnection.fyi/project/southern-company-26-ic-1490, which passed the verifier and are cited here. Because those copies are a lead site, every value stays at medium confidence until a utility or Public Service Commission filing names the project. The two requests share a line and dates, so they are treated as one plant with two units. The plant is named after the substation and county. Not found: the owner, the plant name, the turbine model, the exact site and the coordinates. Moselle power station in Jones County is the nearest GEM gas plant. It is a different plant. The Southern Company queue rows for requests 26-IC-1489 and 26-IC-1490 give no customer name. No Public Service Commission filing, county record or news report naming a company was found, so the owner is blank.
